== Research Notes ==

A possible identification concerns David Mathy. David Mathy and Robert Glasgow were fellow Glasgow burgesses and witnesses to the same sasine on 10 May 1554.<ref>Inspected historical source; [https://archive.org/details/abstractsofproto01glas record].</ref> Published protocol evidence supports a repeated social network; it establishes no kinship between the Glasgow burgh and Stevenston households. The identification remains uncertain.

A possible identification concerns David Mathy. The 3 February 1550/51 barn purchase expressly names David Mathy and Mergaret Androsoune as spouses.<ref>Renwick, Abstracts of Protocols of Town Clerks of Glasgow,vol1,protocol71; printed p. 27 (PDF p. 60); [https://archive.org/details/abstractsofproto01glas/page/n60/mode/1up record].</ref> Inspected printed protocol abstract; original manuscript uninspected. The identification remains uncertain.
